generalAbilities.name: Motion Sense
generalAbilities.description: A creeping evil can feel nearby motion through vibration and air movement.

offensiveAbilities.name: Slithering Strike
offensiveAbilities.description: The creeping evil Strides twice, then makes a pseudopod Strike. The target is Off-Guard against this Strike unless it has seen a Slithering Strike before.

offensiveAbilities.name: Stir Doubts
offensiveAbilities.description: The creeping evil reaches psychically into a creature's innermost thoughts, taking hold of that creature's insecurities and bringing them to front of mind. One creature Grabbed or Restrained by the creeping evil takes 4d8 Mental Damage damage (Basic DC 28 Will Saving Throw save). A creature that fails the save is also Frightened 1 (or Frightened 2 on a critical failure).

offensiveAbilities.name: Variable Volume
offensiveAbilities.description: The creeping evil squeezes itself into a container or other space large enough to fit a Tiny creature. It can exit the container by taking this action again, immediately returning to its normal size. If creatures or objects would occupy the creeping evil's space, it automatically pushes those creatures and objects out of the way to fill a space.

offensiveAbilities.name: Grab
offensiveAbilities.description:
See rules...

Requirements The monster's last action was a successful Strike that lists Grab in its damage entry, or the monster has a creature Grabbed or Restrained

Effect If used after a Strike, the monster attempts to Grapple the creature using the body part it attacked with. This attempt neither applies nor counts toward the creature's multiple attack penalty.

The monster can instead use Grab and choose one creature it's grabbing or restraining with an appendage that has Grab to automatically extend that condition to the end of the monster's next turn.
